• 25 March: «The Annunciation» – feast icon (model: Șcheii Brașovului, 19th century)

• And now, just the icon of «the Annunciation»

• “Who could clearly describe the emotion of the Archangel Gabriel, sent to announce to Mary, an earthly woman living a heavenly life, that she would conceive and give birth to the Creator of heaven and earth?”

• At its centre, the icon painted on glass shows the scene of the Annunciation to the Mother of God by the Archangel Gabriel: that she would give birth, as a man, to the Son of God. • Saint «Ephraim the New» is celebrated on 5 May

• Saint «Ephraim the New» (1384–1426) is one of the most beloved saints of the Orthodox Church in modern times, called the “quick helper” and a great wonderworker. He is also known as a great martyr, a wonderworker and a swift healer of illness, especially cancer, depression and addiction.

• From the age of 14, Saint Ephraim the New lived in the Monastery of the Annunciation near Nea Makri, where he was also martyred.

cb283f19dcf9:
“The Burning Bush of the Theotokos”, icon painted on glass

▪︎ This icon is inspired by several depictions, one of them being the first such icon to reach our country, in the 1940s, at the Antim Monastery in Bucharest. Many generations of the Church's servants and of the faithful have prayed before this icon at the Antim Monastery, and it also inspired the well-known hesychast movement “The Burning Bush”, a group that kept the fire of faith alive in the hearts of many Romanians during the communist rule.

▪︎ The icon “The Burning Bush” shows a large eight-pointed star in the form of overlapping rhombuses, with the Mother of God holding the Saviour in her arms at their centre. Four of the eight points are red, representing the fire, and the other four, painted green, symbolise that the bush did not burn but remained whole. On the points of the red star are the symbols of the four Holy Evangelists: the angel (Saint Matthew), the lion (Saint Mark), the ox (Saint Luke) and the eagle (Saint John), and on the four points of the green star the Holy Angels are depicted.

▪︎ The icon is not available. If you would like an icon on this theme, contact us.

Jesus Christ is painted in the centre, shown frontally, in a high bust. The image of Jesus is set within a border with a “rope motif”. Each saint is framed in a medallion: Saint John the Evangelist and the Holy Apostles Peter, Paul, Matthew, Luke, Simon, Philip, James, Bartholomew, Thomas, Andrew and Mark.

7064efa4ca9d:
• 15 January: Mihai Eminescu's Day and the Day of National Culture

• Together with “Rise over me, O gentle light” by the incomparable poet, we celebrate the Day of National Culture with an icon of the Mother of God, “the Unfading Flower”

• The Mother of God, Eminescu's “gentle light”:

“Rise over me, O gentle light, once more,
As in my heavenly dream of long ago;
O holy mother, virgin evermore,
Come to the night of all my thoughts below.

Do not let my last hope die away,
Although my sins are heaped up mountain-high;
With your warm gaze, so full of mercy, pray,
Look down with pity on me from the sky.

A stranger to all, lost in the deep pain
Of my own nothingness and frailty,
I can believe no more, my strength is gone.

Give me my youth, give back my faith again,
And from your starry heaven come to me,
That I may love you, Mary, from now on!”
